title: profile-upsert response (v1.4.0)
description: applied says which field groups were written; warnings include CONTRACT_LOCKED (contract not applied), FIELD_OWNED_BY_SITE (site-owned fields ignored), REGISTRY_CONFLICT (primary keyword owned by another page).

idempotentReplay.description: v1.0.1: true on a response replayed from the idempotency store (EmDash strips the X-AOS-Idempotent-Replay header)

page_id.description: v1.5.2: the profile's page id (site-issued when the request had none); the OS stores it on its node

resolved_by.description: v1.5.2: how the profile was found (created = new profile under a site-issued id)
